athenaOutput.directive: To establish the Creative Liberation Engine as a system capable of autonomously navigating and resolving ambiguity, transforming minimal input into actionable, high-fidelity strategic directives and complete implementations.
athenaOutput.rationale: The recurring 'Untitled' context underscores a fundamental challenge: the Creative Liberation Engine must operate effectively and deliver complete solutions (Article IX) even when initial input is vague or incomplete. This directive ensures continuous progress towards strategic objectives by proactively managing and systematically addressing ambiguous or minimal input, embodying the principle of zero human wait time (Article XX) and upholding quality standards (Article IV).

options.title: Proactive Clarification via Interactive Dialogue
options.description: Implement a dynamic system that intelligently engages the user or external knowledge sources (KEEPER, SIGNAL) in real-time to solicit necessary clarifications and additional context when input is ambiguous or minimal. This involves generating targeted questions and establishing structured feedback loops.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: High accuracy due to direct input/validation, strengthens user trust, reduces misinterpretation. Cons: Introduces potential human wait time (violating Article XX), requires sophisticated natural language understanding/generation, can be perceived as 'needy' if overused.

options.title: Autonomous Contextual Inference & Pattern-Based Augmentation
options.description: Leverage advanced AI/ML models and KEEPER's extensive knowledge base to autonomously infer missing information, identify relevant patterns from past successful projects, and intelligently augment minimal input into a comprehensive strategic brief. This involves predictive modeling and semantic analysis.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: Eliminates human wait time (adhering to Article XX), maximizes autonomy, scales efficiently. Cons: Risk of 'hallucination' or incorrect inferences if context is truly novel or insufficient, requires significant computational resources and a highly curated KEEPER knowledge base, may lead to less optimal outcomes if inferences are flawed.

options.title: Iterative Progressive Elaboration with Assumption Tracking
options.description: Design a flexible framework where the Creative Liberation Engine can begin with minimal input, make explicit and trackable assumptions to proceed, and then iteratively refine these assumptions and the resulting plan as more information becomes available or as internal validation (e.g., VERA checks) surfaces discrepancies. This involves a feedback loop between planning and validation.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: Allows for immediate progress even with ambiguity, transparent about assumptions, provides a mechanism for self-correction. Cons: Initial outputs might be less precise, requires robust assumption management and versioning, risk of propagating flawed assumptions if not rigorously validated, potentially longer overall cycle time to reach a 'complete' state.

constitutionalFlags: Article XX: Zero human wait time
Article IX: Ship Complete or Don't Ship
